interpretation: The self-evolution loop can now distinguish a local branch from a candidate framework and from an active scoped framework.  Promotion requires conservative generalization, not just local utility.
validation_scope: Implements the self_evo_roadmap conservative-generalization principle.  A new framework is promoted only if it explains residuals, preserves old successes, reduces to parent frameworks under their scope conditions, gains generality, and creates new testable consequences.  The gate emits graph patches and promotion decisions but does not mutate the main graph.
